# vendor

- `mermaid.min.js`: Mermaid 11.4.1 (`dist/mermaid.min.js` of the npm package `mermaid@11.4.1`, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@11.4.1/dist/mermaid.min.js). MIT license, see `LICENSE-mermaid`.

`docs_index.py build` uses this copy by default. Overrides: `--mermaid PATH`, env `DOCS_MERMAID_JS`, or `docs_index.py fetch-mermaid`.
